\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-11},
  title = {Serving explains predictions without the \texorpdfstring{\texttt{shap}}{shap} package},
  note = {\textbf{Absorbs EDN-09} (2026-09-22): the project moved to Python 3.12 so that \texttt{shap} runs for offline analysis.},
  date = {2026-09-22},
  milestone = {M4: Model Deployment},
  topic = {ML System Design, Explainability},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {The API computes FR-08's per-request explanation from the booster's own SHAP export, LightGBM's \texttt{predict(pred\_\allowbreak{}contrib=\allowbreak{}True)}.
The \texttt{shap} package is used for offline analysis only and is never installed in the API image.
The project runs on Python 3.12, which \texttt{shap} requires.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item \texttt{shap.\allowbreak{}TreeExplainer} in the serving path: one implementation everywhere, but \texttt{shap} imports \texttt{numba} and \texttt{llvmlite} at load, and both would enter the image.
\item Stay on Python 3.11 without \texttt{shap}: the offline analysis, such as summary plots, still needs the package.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} The native export returns the same TreeSHAP values, so serving loses nothing and the image stays inside the size budget of NFR-04 with more headroom.
CatBoost has an equivalent export, so the choice survives a change of model.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI first proposed the native export as a workaround for a conflict under Python 3.11.
Lukas asked it to check a version bump instead, and a scratch resolve and install under 3.12 with the planned dependencies found no blocker.
AI then built Docker images with and without \texttt{shap} and compared the two explanations.
Lukas confirmed on that evidence.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-09-22, review of PR \#19; Lukas asked: ``is this what we would want? or are there better options?''.},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/specification.md}{Specification} FR-08, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/project-brief.md}{project brief} section 6, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/pull/19}{PR \#19}.},
}
